tasks.statement_en: Solve the system of equations: $|x|-y=1$ and $x^2+(y+1)^2=8$.
tasks.notes: Substituting y+1=|x| gives 2x^2=8, x=2 or x=-2, both give y=1 (y=-3 branch rejected since |x| cannot be negative). Solutions (2,1) and (-2,1); sum of all four numbers = 2. [verified: ok: y+1=|x| gives x=+-2, y=1 (key 12.3). 'Rozwiaz' = full solution set; sum of all coords 2. Summary fix: diacritics + 'wszystkich'.]

tasks.summary_en: From the graph of $f'$, find $x$ where $f$ has a maximum (part b)
tasks.statement_en: The figure shows the graph of the derivative of a function f, crossing the x-axis at x=-4, x=0 and x=4 (with a local maximum of f' near x=-2.5 and a local minimum of f' near x=2). a) State the maximal intervals on which f is decreasing. b) Find the value of x for which f attains a local maximum; justify your answer. c) Given that point A=(1,2) lies on the graph of f, write the equation of the tangent line to the curve f at point A.
tasks.notes: Only part b) is numeric (x=0, where f' changes sign from + to -). Part a) (decreasing intervals (-inf,-4] and [0,4]) and part c) (tangent line y=-2x+4) are symbolic/set-valued and excluded from the sum, per key.

tasks.statement_en: Points A=(7,8) and B=(-1,2) are vertices of triangle ABC in which the measure of angle BCA is 90 degrees. a) Find the coordinates of vertex C, given that it lies on the OX axis. b) Write the equation of the image of the circle circumscribed about triangle ABC under the homothety with center P=(1,0) and scale factor k=-2.
tasks.notes: Only part a) is numeric: C=(3,0), sum of coordinates = 3 (verified: C on OX with BC perpendicular AC). Part b) (image circle equation (x+3)^2+(y+10)^2=100) is symbolic and excluded from the sum.
